production_review.binding: The gate runs after template-local and real definition-function bindings have precedence and only for proven direct make/new builtins. Captured callees remain caller expressions. Type leaves cannot use capture placeholders or template-local bindings; genuine primitives use existing definition/caller checks.
production_review.nested_alias: Only exact engine aliases whose keys are type <predeclared primitive> are trusted. Capture/local checks precede alias acceptance; generated-looking user spellings and sum aliases are not trusted. Existing inner-definition identity is not reinterpreted in outer definition scope.
production_review.array_length: Array.Len stays an expression slot. Complete caller captures are opaque, while explicit template type nodes inside composite literals, assertions and pointer conversions are checked. Constantness is left to Go.
production_review.complexity: Slice nil length is guarded. The expression walk skips types already recursively checked while preserving literal-element and assertion-operand traversal, avoiding the identified exponential revisit. The persistent depth40 occurrence-count check and independent depth24 CLI runtime probe cover this regression.
production_review.semantics: Generated native allocation remains direct, with no wrapper or change to storage, multiplicity, propagation frames or reference checks. Plain make operand order is compared with the same native Go toolchain, not hard-coded to an assumed lexical order.
